Right now everything has been discussed through calls, texts, and informal promises, and I need a serious agreement between my company and their team. We need clear compensation terms with a $10,000 monthly retainer plus 7% commission on signed projects they directly source, payable only after the client’s deposit clears, with chargeback/clawback if the client cancels within 45 days. We also need reimbursement rules for approved events, travel, photography, and paid ads. Need ownership and use rules for leads, CRM records, before/after photography, design boards, staging photos, ad creatives, landing pages, newsletter lists, and social media assets.
